C9000165.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 165 (The Harary–Hill and Zarankiewicz crossing-number formulas.; papers: The crossing number of complete graphs; The crossing number of complete bipartite graphs; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/165.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_CYCLE_PAIRING.statement: The manuscript corrected pairing vanishes on every pair of real graph cycles, with shared edges, repeated crossings, and arbitrary vertex cuts.

C_SWEEP_LOCAL.statement: The signed segment crossing plus shared-endpoint correction equals the explicit ray-potential incidence formula.

C_INCIDENCE_FACTOR.statement: A skew pairing of the explicit incidence-factorized form annihilates all pairs of real zero-boundary chains.

C_DRAWING_REDUCTION.statement: Every normalized polygonal drawing reduces to generic left-to-right segments without changing the corrected pairing on original cycle chains.

C_CUT_INVARIANCE.statement: Changing any vertex-order cut leaves the corrected pairing on zero-boundary chains unchanged.

C_NORMALIZATION.statement: The manuscript drawing normalization preserves or lowers the number of spatial crossing points.

C_COMPLETE_DETECTOR.statement: Two-triangle interpolation makes the complete-graph even-node order pairing nondegenerate.

C_COMPLETE_INJECTIVITY.statement: The complete-graph support evaluation map is injective by polynomial cycle tests and order detection.

C_COMPLETE_FORMULA.statement: For n at least 3, cr(K_n) equals the Harary-Hill product of four floors divided by four.

C_COMPLETE_DIMENSION.statement: The isotropic-image dimension argument and vertex deletion yield the claimed complete-graph lower bounds from injectivity.

C_COMPLETE_UPPER.statement: The stated two-page drawing has exactly the Harary-Hill number of crossings.

C_BIPARTITE_ADDITIVE.statement: The rectangular block difference of J is row-plus-column additive.

C_BIPARTITE_RANKSUM.statement: The subspace-intersection inequality implies the stated rank-sum corollary for invertible diagonal differences.

C_BIPARTITE_DETECTOR.statement: The bipartite rank detector annihilates additive and diagonal matrices and is invertible on every local linear-order sign matrix.

C_BIPARTITE_FORMULA.statement: For positive m,n, cr(K_m,n) equals the Zarankiewicz product of four floors.

C_BIPARTITE_DELETION.statement: Deleting and averaging vertices extends the odd-side bipartite lower bound to even side sizes.

C_BIPARTITE_UPPER.statement: The balanced-axis construction attains the claimed bipartite crossing number.
